svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.9.8.1 Measurement of Travel Distance
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.9.8.1 Measurement of Travel Distance
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.9 MEANS OF EGRESS
Measurement of Travel Distance

g.text: From any point in the floor area to an exit,
measured along the path of exit travel
Room or suite behind a 45 min fire separation:
(the path inside it, dashed, is not counted)

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Travel distance means the distance from any
point in the floor area to an exit, measured
along the path of exit travel
For the purposes of this Subsection. Except as
provided in Sentences (2) and (3).
Where a room or suite is separated from the
rest of the floor area by a fire separation
with a fire-resistance rating of at least 45
min, the travel distance may be measured from
an egress door of the room or suite to the
nearest exit
In a sprinklered building, the fire separation is
not required to have a fire-resistance rating.
Where a public corridor is not less than 9 m
(29′-6⅜″) wide and conforms to Subclauses
3.4.2.5.(1)(d)(i) to (d)(iv), the travel
distance may be determined in accordance with
those Subclauses
Drawn: one floor area, walls cut low. Pink walls: fire separations of the suites and exits. Green: travel distance.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.9.8.1. (page 9-52)
